svg.text: 1024x1024 · stem base y=1000 · object height ~880 (86% of frame) · light from UPPER-LEFT on every plant
outlines 13 main / 12 prop / 11 fine — 11px is the FLOOR (0.9px at game size ghosts out) · round joins + caps · two-tone hard-edged, never a gradient
canopy_blob(n, jit, bul) and the root foot take a PER-PLANT seed. They are required arguments on purpose.
TRUNK / STEM + BRANCH + THE GROUND ANCHOR
y = 1000. root_pts(seed, lobes, depth) — the foot is PER PLANT. Default notches 16-30px;
deeper reads as claws, so opt in explicitly when you actually want claws (a xylophone tree does).
RECTILINEAR / MECHANICAL — the opt-out of smooth_closed
shadow = base hue, ~10 deg cooler, S +0.05, V -0.09..-0.14, hard edge
silly + wacky only. state = eyes(1) + mouth(1) [+ brows(1)]. Blush always on.
anchors, eye radius and mouth are per-plant arguments; face width must be 45-60% of its mass.
